request.style: English, Male solo voice, warm and intimate, piano, acoustic guitar, cello, strings, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Thomas fell to his knees in the room
My Lord and my God he cried out loud
Jesus spoke words of grace and truth
Blessed are those who believe without sight

[Chorus]
These things are written for you to see
Believe Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God
By believing you may have life
Found in his name, in his name

[Verse]
Many other signs were done before
In the presence of his disciples then
Not all are recorded in this book
But the purpose is clear and true

[Chorus]
These things are written for you to see
Believe Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God
By believing you may have life
Found in his name, in his name

[Bridge]
Not just for Thomas who touched the scars
But for all who trust without seeing
The record stands to guide your heart
To faith that lasts and never fades

[Outro]
Believe that Jesus is the Christ
And have life in his name
